title: Which Phone, Grandma?

slices.alt: Comic, part 1 of 13: Verdict Picks Toon: Which Phone, Grandma?
Comic, part 2 of 13: Caption: Thanksgiving night. The Black Friday deals are already up. Jo: Grandma, I'm getting you earbuds. The fancy white ones are on sale!
Comic, part 3 of 13: Caption: Earbuds are built around one kind of phone. The sale ad rarely says which.
Comic, part 4 of 13: Grandma June: Lovely, dear. Will they work with my phone? Grandma June: It's the one your cousin set up. Not an iPhone.
Comic, part 5 of 13: Jo: NOT AN IPHONE?!
Comic, part 6 of 13: Vera: On Android, AirPods work as plain Bluetooth earbuds. Vera: No instant pairing, no Find My, most of the settings gone.

Comic, part 7 of 13: Board, Match the earbuds to the phone first: iPhone AirPods Pro 3; Samsung Galaxy Galaxy Buds4 Pro; Pixel or other Android Sony WF-1000XM6; Any phone, under $100 Soundcore Liberty 4 NC Source: our guide's phone-and-budget table, November 2026.
Comic, part 8 of 13: Jo: So the sale price comes second? Vera: Phone first. Then compare the price with the list price, in dollars.

Comic, part 9 of 13: Board, Black Friday week: list price vs. seen: AirPods Pro 3 (Walmart) $249 → $149; Galaxy Buds4 Pro (Samsung) $249.99 → $179.99; Sony WF-1000XM6 (Best Buy) $329.99 → $250 Sources: Macworld, Nov 25; Samsung.com, Nov 26; CNN Underscored, Nov 23, 2026.
Comic, part 10 of 13: Caption: The next morning. Grandma June: This one feels loose. Jo: Try another tip size. Lots of people need a different size in each ear.
Comic, part 11 of 13: Vera: Fit is what happy owners mention first. Run the fit test in the app, too. Vera: And keep the receipt. One bud that stops charging is the classic complaint.
Comic, part 12 of 13: Grandma June: Jo! The dishwasher stopped! Jo: It's still running, Grandma. That's noise cancelling.

Comic, part 13 of 13: Caption: Phone first, fit second, price third. The full comparison of twelve pairs is below. Vera: Pick your phone's row. Which earbuds fit your phone? Twelve pairs, compared below.
